review: Root independently compared each divine proposal with supplied PHB pp48,52–55,58,60–62; aerial scope with DMG50. Detect Lie secondary errata is explicitly attributed, original magazine not inspected.

changes.oldValue: Range and the level-dependent table remain withheld: the OCR drops the range unit and has overlapping table bands. Check printed p.48.
changes.newValue: The printed p.48 entry gives the range as “1” without a visible unit; its level table overlaps at 7th level. The referee must resolve those uncertainties.
changes.reason: The printed source itself shows a range of 1 with no visible unit and overlapping 7th-level bands; this is not merely an OCR issue.

changes.oldValue: OCR conflict: spell list p.40 places this at level 4; description header p.48 reads level 3. This record follows the list pending visual review.
changes.newValue: PHB p.40 lists this spell at level 4, while its p.48 description labels it level 3. A secondary transcription of Dragon #35 errata reports a correction to level 4; this record follows the spell list.
changes.reason: Printed list and spell description disagree; Acaeum transcribes Dragon #35 correction 48A as level 4. The original magazine has not been inspected.

changes.oldValue: Range is withheld because its OCR unit is missing.
changes.newValue: The printed p.48 entry gives the range as “1” without a visible unit.
changes.reason: The source page itself omits a visible unit, rather than this being an OCR-only problem.

changes.oldValue: One tree in three is uprooted. Structures take 5–60 structural damage, with fully damaged structures collapsing.
changes.newValue: One tree in three is uprooted. Structures take 5d12 structural damage, with fully damaged structures collapsing.
changes.reason: The printed p.53 table visibly gives 5–60 points as 5d12.

changes.oldValue: Terrain-specific results are in the source table; structural damage dice are withheld because OCR is corrupted.
changes.newValue: Terrain effects: cave or cavern roofs collapse; cliffs crumble in landslides; ground cracks open, killing creatures that fall in (size S: 1 in 4; M: 1 in 6; L: 1 in 8); marsh drains and becomes muddy, rough ground; tunnels cave in.
changes.reason: The printed terrain table on p.52 is legible; structural damage dice appear on p.53.

changes.oldValue: The HD-dependent effect table is not reliably extracted: OCR corrupts some bands/durations. Consult printed p.53 for exact outcomes.
changes.newValue: Creatures of differing alignment: less than 4 HD or levels are killed; 4 to 7+ are paralyzed for 1–4 turns; 8 to 11+ are stunned for 2–8 rounds, move at −50%, and attack at −4; 12 or more are deafened for 1–4 rounds, move at −25%, attack at −2, and have a 50% spell failure chance. The plus signs are printed in the table.
changes.reason: The PHB p.53 table is visually legible; transcribe all printed bands and associated effects while preserving its plus signs.

changes.oldValue: Exact passenger capacity is withheld: OCR ties it to 8-level increments up to level 24 but its wording conflicts with the stated one-or-two-companion limit. Check printed p.54.
changes.newValue: The printed p.54 text says one or two other persons, but also describes another person for every eight cleric levels up to 24; exact passenger capacity remains unclear.
changes.reason: Visual review confirms the apparent tension is in the printed text, not merely OCR.

changes.oldValue: An overt attempt by the druid to harm the subject, or successful dispel magic, breaks it. Renewal-save schedule is OCR transcribed and awaits visual confirmation.
changes.newValue: An overt attempt by the druid to harm the subject, or successful dispel magic, breaks the spell.
changes.reason: The p.55 renewal-save table was visually inspected and agrees with the listed schedule; visual confirmation is no longer pending.

changes.oldValue: Exact restricted movement speed is withheld because the OCR omits its time unit.
changes.newValue: The printed p.58 description gives movement as 1″ per unspecified interval, or 2″ per unspecified interval for larger-than-man-sized creatures; the time unit is not printed.
changes.reason: Visual examination confirms the movement time unit is missing in the printed source, not just its OCR.
